description: This Swift source file defines a JPEG transcoder with error handling. It provides functionality to re-encode JPEG images, possibly downscaling and controlling quality to meet size constraints, while normalizing orientation and extracting image properties.

classes.name: JPEGTranscodeError
classes.description: An enumeration representing possible errors during JPEG transcoding, including decode failure, missing properties, encode failure, and size limit exceeding.

methods.name: errorDescription
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description for each error case.

classes.name: JPEGTranscoder
classes.description: A struct that provides static methods for JPEG image processing, including encoding, decoding, downscaling, quality adjustment, and handling size constraints.

methods.name: clampQuality
methods.description: Clamps the quality parameter to be within 0.05 and 1.0.

methods.name: transcodeToJPEG
methods.description: Main function to re-encode an image to JPEG, optionally resizing and adjusting quality to meet size constraints, while normalizing orientation.
